steps: Sift the salt and flour into a mixing bowl, cut in the lard with a knife, then add the cold water slowly until the whole mass can be taken up on the knife without crumbling.
Peal and slice the apples, place them in a greased pie plate, sprinkle over the sugar quantity to use, depends upon the tartness of the apples), add seasoning and dot with a tablespoonful of lard.

Roll the dough out on a floured board, cut and place it over the apples, press the edge with a floured fork and trim. Then prick the crust with a fork to allow the steam to escape and bake in medium hot oven until apples are tender and crust browned. When serving, cut with a knife, lay crust on plate, upside down and heap the apple on it.
